outer.label: EI
outer.selectionReason: EI preserves EH's accepted photo-first composition but makes the Japanese destination word itself the dominant editorial image: 横浜 is 112px while ふたり旅。 is materially smaller at 58px, Feature 01 has a stronger number/title scale relationship, and Feature 02 is enlarged and pushed further across the hero/lower-photo boundary. This improves thumbnail recognition and Japanese travel-magazine silhouette without adding rounded cards, shadows, gradients, or generic UI furniture.
rejectedIntermediates: Initial EI placed the 80px Feature 01 number at x=16, inside the bounded 18px safe-area heuristic. It was moved to x=20 and the candidate was re-verified before promotion.
